parameters.query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('items',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) FROM (SELECT id,finding_type,entity_type,canonical_key,field_name,expected_value,actual_value,severity,status,title,created_at FROM findings WHERE inspection_id=$1::uuid ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST($3::integer,1),100) OFFSET (GREATEST($2::integer,1)-1)*LEAST(GREATEST($3::integer,1),100)) p),'[]'::jsonb),'page',GREATEST($2::integer,1),'page_size',LEAST(GREATEST($3::integer,1),100),'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM findings WHERE inspection_id=$1::uuid)) AS data
